title: DIGISEQ-DT2
author: Robbie (DIGISEQ for Digitakt); Digitakt II 1.17 port
description: DIGISEQ for the Digitakt II, OS 1.17: sequencer types a track plays in place of its own trigs, chosen per track (TYPE: OFF, SNAKE or 185), on all 16 tracks, audio and MIDI. SNAKE: a Cartesian sequencer after MDD Snake (and Make Noise's Rene), eight cells in a 4 x 2 grid walked by a path. 185: a stage sequencer after ML-185 (and RYK's M-185): eight stages, each with a pitch, a velocity, a length of 1-8 clock pulses and a mode (OFF, ONE, ALL every DIV pulses, HOLD for the whole stage), with DIR, STAGES, CLOCK (1/8 .. 1X), SCALE, RANGE, note LEN and SHIFT. Ported from Robbie's DIGISEQ for Digitakt 0.2; replaces DIGISNAKE-DT2. Press TRIG on the TRIG page until its pages come round to open it; hold TRIG + UP / DOWN changes TYPE. Not on the Digitakt II yet: PRINT and CLOCK 2X. Not saved with the project. Experimental.
